narrative: At every Mandelbrot bifurcation the number of branches is fixed by local algebra and equals the period of the bulb, turning the boundary into a tree of finite dice. Assigning uniform probability 1/n to each n-fold branch yields a harmonic measure that naturally weights simpler, lower-period branches more heavily — grounding the consonance hierarchy in the structure of the set rather than in imposed musical convention.
